title: Filled skutterudites: from single to multiple filling
body: Research on traditional thermoelectric (TE) materials with narrow bandgap have made great progress in recent years. Here, we primarily reviewed the study on CoSb3 skuttuerdites with intrinsic crystal voids that could be partially filled with various filler atoms for TE performance optimization. By combining experimental measurement of electrical/thermal transport properties and theoretical study of electronic structure and structural stability, we analyzed the fundamentals in understanding the filling behavior of fillers atoms in the voids, and provided a few guidance rules in simultaneously optimizing electrical and thermal transport properties for thermoelectric performance optimization. By following those rules, nearly independent tunning of electron and phonon transports can be achieved in these caged compounds. As a result, these partially filled skutterudites basically satisfy the picture of the ‘phonon glass-electron crystal’ paradigm, and TE figure of merit (ZT) was pushed up to reach 1.7@850 K, highest among all reported bulk TE materials. The general discussions could also provide guidance in searching for novel thermoelectric materials.

body: 高潮と高波浪の重畳によって浸水事象が発生している.高潮・波浪による浸水事象の再現期間を推定するために,本研究では,浸水を引き起こす外力である潮位偏差・波浪・天文潮位に着目し,最大潮位偏差および最大有義波高の従属性を考慮した多変量極値統計解析手法に天文潮位を考慮して再現期間を推定する手法を提案した.その手法を,2019年台風19号による高潮・高波浪によって浸水が発生した清水港における観測データに適用して,その事象の再現期間を197年と推定した.一方,潮位偏差と波浪の従属性を考慮せずに推定した,最大潮位と最大有義波高の同時生起再現期間は1.7万年以上であった.この手法から得られる再現期間は,浸水現象を引き起こす潮位偏差・波浪・天文潮位の統計的特性の理解を深め,リスクマネジメントに寄与する.

title: The Invisible Engine A Probabilistic and Taphonomic Analysis of High-Value Tool Survivorship in the Fourth Dynasty Archaeological Record
body: This paper challenges the "Pompeii Premise"-the fallacy that the archaeological record represents a frozen, representative snapshot of past material culture. We argue that the systematic absence of high-value metal tools from Fourth Dynasty (c. 2613-2494 BCE) Egyptian sites is not evidence of their non-existence, but a predictable outcome of economic and taphonomic processes. By synthesizing data from economic anthropology, behavioral archaeology, and material science (corrosion kinetics), this study demonstrates that high-value utilitarian tools were subject to extreme curation and near-total recycling, analogous to modern heavy machinery. We develop a novel mathematical model that integrates recycling rates, chemical destruction in saline soils, and archaeological sampling fractions. The model proves that the probability of recovering such tools approaches zero (E[N_rec] ≈ 0.04), making their absence a mathematical certainty rather than an archaeological mystery. This work provides a rigorous, quantitative framework for understanding survivorship bias in archaeology, forcing a re-evaluation of technological capabilities inferred solely from recovered artifacts. Keywords: Archaeological Methodology, Formation Processes, Survivorship Bias, Taphonomy, Egyptian Archaeology, Old Kingdom, Fourth Dynasty, Corrosion Kinetics, Behavioral Archaeology, Tool Curation, Pompeii Premise, Recycling, Giza Plateau

title: Hybrid Prophet-TCN Framework for Deterministic and Probabilistic Wind-Power Forecasting
body: Accurate wind-power forecasting is essential for maintaining grid stability under high renewable penetration. This paper presents a hybrid Prophet-Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) model that combines structural time-series decomposition with deep nonlinear temporal modeling for turbine-level point and probabilistic forecasting. Prophet captures long-term trend and weekly, monthly, yearly seasonalities with meteorological regressors, while the TCN learns short-term multivariate dependencies from 30-day windows using dilated causal convolutions with residual and normalized blocks. A lightweight attention layer adaptively weights the two branch outputs to produce the final hybrid forecast. The model is evaluated on a four-year dataset from Jeju Island, South Korea, comprising 1,461 daily observations from five turbines and 42 meteorological variables. The hybrid forecaster achieves seasonal R2 values up to 0.9483 and monthly MAE and RMSE as low as 25.8 MWh and 37.8 MWh. Daily and seasonal analyses show R2 generally above 0.86, with performance degrading only under the most volatile winter conditions. Probabilistic evaluation using CRPS, pinball loss at τ =0.1,0.5,0.9, and prediction-interval coverage at 80% and 90% indicates well-calibrated uncertainty, with CRPS closely aligned with MAE and coverage typically within 3-4 percentage points of nominal levels. Overall, the proposed Prophet-TCN framework provides accurate, interpretable, and operationally robust wind-power forecasts suitable for risk-aware grid operation and energy planning.

title: Molten Salts, Electrochemical Tests, High Temperature Corrosion, 316L Stainless Steel, Eis.
body: La generación de electricidad a partir de Concentradores Solares Térmicos (CST) ha surgido como una solución a la búsqueda de fuentes alternativas de energía que sean comercialmente aceptables. Los CST son los equipos encargados de la recolección, acumulación y transporte de la energía solar y la investigación en esta área está centrada tanto en el mejoramiento de materiales para la fabricación de los espejos reflectores, como en los fluidos termotransportadores para posibilitar el almacenamiento de energía en los períodos en los que no se cuenta con la radiación solar. Se utilizan sales fundidas como fluido termotransportador debido a que pueden almacenar energía térmica por varias horas durante la noche. Generalmente, se emplean mezclas binarias y ternarias que son estables a altas temperaturas, aunque presentan el inconveniente de que a temperaturas de alrededor de 600°C, las sales pueden descomponerse con el consiguiente riesgo de corrosión del sistema. Se evaluó la velocidad de corrosión del acero inoxidable 316L en varias mezclas de sales fundidas de NaNO2, NaNO3, KNO3, Ca(NO3)2 y LiNO3, por medio de Resistencia a la Polarización Lineal, Espectroscopia de Impedancia Electroquímica y Polarización Potenciodinámica, en un rango de temperatura de 450 a 550°C. Se utilizó un sistema de tres electrodos, con alambre de oro como electrodos de referencia y auxiliar. Se probaron 9 mezclas y en cada una se varió la concentración de las sales y la presencia de algunas de ellas. Los resultados indican que con el aumento de la temperatura, se incrementa la velocidad de corrosión. Asimismo, el menor deterioro del material se dio con las mezclas que tenían LiNO3. Además, se usó SEM para caracterizar el material antes y después del ataque corrosivo. También se utilizó la técnica DRX para determinar el tipo de compuestos se formaron luego de la reacción de corrosión.

title: Mechanisms of mobility and retention of nano-TiO2 in acidic porous media in the presence of humus acids
body: 探讨了富里酸(FA)和胡敏酸(HA)存在条件下饱和石英砂填充柱中纳米二氧化钛(nTiO2)的迁移和滞留机制.结果表明,pH4.0条件下,不存在FA和HA时,nTiO2不发生迁移;FA和HA吸附到nTiO2表面,改变nTiO2电动性质,促进其在饱和多孔介质柱中迁移.随着FA和HA浓度由1mg/L升高至10mg/L,nTiO2的流出率(填充柱流出液与进液中nTiO2总量的比值)分别由0.01和0.88升高至0.91和0.94;相同条件下,HA在nTiO2表面的吸附量比FA大,对nTiO2迁移性的促进作用也更大.离子抑制nTiO2的迁移,且CaCl2影响大于NaCl.相同NaCl浓度,与FA相比,HA作用下nTiO2的迁移性更强,并且7%~56%的nTiO2沉降在第二极小势能区,高于FA作用下的4%~17%,更易被重新释放.nTiO2与石英砂之间的高势垒促进nTiO2的迁移,而低势垒、第二最小势能、阻塞作用、扩散和重力沉降是nTiO2滞留的主要原因.

title: Spatiochemical Segregation in Porous Lithium-Metal Interphases
body: The solid-electrolyte interphase (SEI) on lithium metal forms through electrolyte reduction at a dynamically evolving metal surface, yet how its chemistry and spatial organization develop during lithium plating and stripping remains poorly understood. Here, using a 1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME)/1 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) electrolyte system, we show that three-dimensional lithium growth drives spatiochemical segregation of interphase products into chemically heterogeneous domains that are mechanically reorganized during stripping into a porous electrolyte-retaining framework. Correlative X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, nanoscale secondary ion mass spectrometry (NanoSIMS), and synchrotron X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveal that FSI--derived inorganic species, dominated by LiF, become enriched in regions spatially decoupled from oxygen-containing phases near the lithium surface. Stripping-induced contraction compacts these chemically distinct domains into confined intergranular volumes, where supersaturation promotes precipitation and consolidation, yielding a porous SEI that retains electrolyte-derived species within a buried pore network beyond the reach of surface-sensitive probes. Spatiochemical segregation thus couples interfacial reaction pathways to lithium chemo-mechanics, dictating interphase composition, architecture, and permeability. These findings establish a chemo-mechanical framework for SEI evolution and suggest strategies to mitigate electrolyte retention and interphase instability in lithium-metal batteries.

title: Modernizing Outdoor Substation Design by the Novel Application of Probabilistic Design Principles
body: This paper proposes a structured design methodology for Air Insulated Switchgear (AIS) substations with nominal voltages exceeding 45 kV, specifically for configurations employing stranded flexible conductors. The approach is based on a rigorous three-dimensional assessment of primary equipment positioning, combined with the coordinated determination of phase-to-earth and phase-to-phase insulation clearances using a probabilistic framework. Clearance values are derived from specified insulation withstand levels, including lightning impulse withstand level (LIWL), switching impulse withstand level (SIWL), and power frequency (PF) withstand criteria, ensuring consistency with established insulation coordination principles. In parallel, the methodology explicitly incorporates short-circuit electromechanical effects to ensure that conductor-induced forces remain within the allowable dynamic strength limits of connected equipment, thereby addressing a critical constraint often underrepresented in legacy design practices. The proposed process defines a bounded design space within which electrical and mechanical requirements are simultaneously satisfied, enabling efficient convergence toward optimized substation layouts. A mathematical formulation for clearance optimization is introduced, accounting for the influence of fault level on permissible equipment separation. Preliminary results indicate improved spatial efficiency compared to conventional deterministic approaches, with coordinated probabilistic clearances enabling reductions of up to 28% through appropriate application of geometry-dependent gap factors, without compromising reliability. The framework further supports systematic design synthesis and verification, and its applicability to the voltage uprating of existing substations is discussed. Definitions of equipment dimensional parameters are provided in the main text.

title: Neuro probabilistic model for the prediction of the air demand in N2-PSA plants including the quantification of its uncertainty
body: N 2 -Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) is a process that efficiently generates pure N 2 from compressed air. However, its design and control strategy are non-trivial due to multivariable interactions between ambient condition, demand situation, and different process variables. Therefore, it is reasonable to expect potential benefits from machine learning tools. As the compressor is the dominant power consumer in these plants, this study presents a neuro probabilistic model for the prediction of the air demand and the quantification of its uncertainty. The authors demonstrate that data point estimators, such as the Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBR), the Random Forest Regressor (RFR) and the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP), trained under the assumption of homoscedasticity, can perform well according to the statistical evaluation metrics. However, by analysing the scatter plot and the residuals distribution, the process's heteroscedasticity is evident. Consequently, deterministic predictions do not provide rigorous uncertainty quantification, leading to decreased reliability. Conversely, the Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) we propose is a valuable approach that provides a distribution of possible outcomes, enabling the prediction of the air demand and the quantification of the aleatoric uncertainty.
